terrain_height — DRIVE terrain op

• Data kinds: image2d × image2d × table → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.terrain_height(x, y, p: 'dict', course=None) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import driveterrain; driveterrain.terrain_height(x, y, p: 'dict', course=None) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("terrain_height"))

Usage

z = fbm(x, y)·w(d(x, y)) + undulation(x, y). Without a course, w = 1 (relief only).
